learningBoundary: Includes concepts supported by the controlled PDF for 9.8 Deformable Systems: Distinction between deformable systems and particle models; Failure of the particle work-kinetic energy theorem for deformable systems; Work evaluated using the displacement of the point of application of the force; Distinction between point of application displacement and center-of-mass displacement; Conservation of energy and transformation of internal energy into kinetic energy; Classification of deformable systems as isolated or nonisolated in terms of energy and momentum.
